notify.nokey: Notifications need {key}, because Foreman keeps webhook addresses sealed with it. The operator guide says how to set it.
notify.empty: No webhooks yet. Add one to hear about crashes, restarts and players in Discord, ntfy or your own service.
notify.unreadable: Foreman cannot read this webhook’s address, so nothing is sent to it. The secret key may have changed. Edit the webhook and type the address again.
notify.delete.question: Delete the {preset} webhook to {host}?
notify.delete.readd: To add it again you need its address.
notify.preset.discord.hint: In Discord: Server settings, Integrations, Webhooks, then Copy webhook URL.
notify.preset.ntfy.hint: The topic’s full address, such as {example}.
notify.preset.generic.hint: Foreman posts a JSON body to the address. The operator guide describes it.
notify.url.label: Webhook address
notify.url.kept: The address is kept: {preset}, {host}. Type a new address to change it.
notify.url.retype: Type the address again. Foreman does not keep an address it refused.
notify.url.long: Enter an address of at most {count} characters.
notify.url.invalid: Enter a whole web address, with no spaces in it.
notify.url.scheme: Enter an address that starts with https:// or http://.
notify.url.plain: Messages to an http:// address are sent unencrypted.
notify.url.unreadable: The stored address cannot be read. Type the address again.
notify.url.user: Enter an address without a user name or password in it.
notify.url.discord: Enter a Discord webhook address. It starts with https://discord.com/api/webhooks/.
notify.url.ntfy: Enter the address of an ntfy topic, such as https://ntfy.sh/your-topic.
notify.url.preset: Type the address again to change the service.
notify.event.scheduled_restart: A scheduled restart runs or is skipped
notify.lang.label: Language of the messages
notify.lang.hint: Names from the game and the world’s name are sent as written.
notify.lang.invalid: Choose a language from the list.
notify.msg.crash_loop: {world}: the server keeps crashing, so Foreman stopped it. Start it again by hand.
notify.msg.restart_skipped: {world}: the scheduled restart was skipped because players stayed online.
notify.msg.low_disk: {world}: only {free} of disk space is free. Autosaves can fail when it runs out.
